propositions: Approximately 2033 lines of comment and docstring content across 439 files in src/rebar are classified as relocatable (history to tickets, architecture to ADRs, contracts to schema, rationale to docs) but should remain as citations rather than move verbatim where load-bearing.
Self-referential prose explaining the 800-line file cap occupies 28 sites in the reconciler, creating ironic over-documentation of the constraint it documents.

Five hotspot files (runner.py, _ref_lock.py, dispatch_one.py, inbound_differ.py, fetcher.py) have recoverable comment headroom but three files (_store/event_append.py, reducer/_processors.py, signing.py) retain comments as load-bearing replay-compat and security invariants.

Verified-stale comments exist at six sites (deterministic floor P1-P9 vs P1-P11, stale Anthropic constraint, stub signatures already implemented, import timing, missing keys in documentation) and must be corrected rather than deleted.

Each of six subsystem shards must produce a do_not_move list recording load-bearing comment blocks (external-API facts, anti-refactor warnings, lint pragmas) that protect against future incorrect relocation.
Eight sites currently duplicate a four-paragraph argument about idempotent transform ordering (fit-then-normalize on local side) and should be consolidated into a single ADR citation.
